source: una calle larga que tenga spawn para objetos y parking para obtener los objetivos con baces para cada jugador y pongo sus objetos allá y se mejore la base hasta el piso 15 y que tenga sistema de dinero velocidad tienda de velocidad

answers.ask: What should the street look like - a modern city block, or something more stylized?
answers.answer: Una calle de ciudad moderna, sencilla y clara, con zona de spawn de objetos y estacionamiento.

answers.ask: What are the spawned objects and what does bringing them to your base do?
answers.answer: Los objetos que aparecen son los objetivos coleccionables; al llevarlos a tu base se colocan allí y generan dinero para mejorarla hasta el piso 15.

answers.ask: How many players and how many bases along the street?
answers.answer: Hazlo para 4 jugadores, con 4 bases, una para cada jugador, alineadas a lo largo de la calle.

answers.ask: How long is the street, and how tall is a fifteen-floor base meant to feel?
answers.answer: La calle debe ser corta y compacta, suficiente para conectar las 4 bases con el spawn y el estacionamiento. Cada base debe crecer verticalmente de forma visible hasta 15 pisos.

config.genre_evidence: “objetivos coleccionables” that players bring to their individual bases, where they “generan dinero para mejorarla hasta el piso 15,” plus a money and speed shop system. The layout is built around an incremental base-building/tycoon loop across 4 player bases.

extras.text: Four individual player bases are aligned along the compact street, each visibly able to grow vertically to fifteen floors.

config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Simulation map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Isolated Per-Player Plots: Massive, independent, equally spaced plots for building out a factory or base without ever overlapping a neighbour.

INCLUDE:
- Upgrades Bazaar: The central storefront zone — eggs, upgrades, progression shops — that every player has to keep coming back to.
- Progression Circulation: Walkable or drivable circulation chaining the hub to wherever value is actually produced.
- Four individual player bases are aligned along the compact street, each visibly able to grow vertically to fifteen floors.
